info.author: Andy Grover
info.name: rtslib-fb
info.summary: API for Linux kernel SCSI target (aka LIO)

vulnerabilities.details: Open-iSCSI rtslib-fb through 2.1.72 has weak permissions for /etc/target/saveconfig.json because shutil.copyfile (instead of shutil.copy) is used, and thus permissions are not preserved.
Python rtslib-fb through 2.1.72 has weak permissions for `/etc/target/saveconfig.json` because shutil.copyfile (instead of shutil.copy) is used, and thus permissions are not preserved.
